line.a_piknik.text: I'm having a picnic on the meadow! I've invited guests.

line.a_dwoje.text: Two guests are already sitting on the blanket: Hedgehog and Mouse.

line.a_ktos_idzie.text: Someone else is coming! It's the duckling.

line.a_jeden.text: One guest! We have one guest!

line.a_nie_jeden.text: Bunny, you only counted the duckling. Hedgehog and Mouse haven't disappeared!

line.a_dodawanie.text: Adding is putting together. First let's bring the duckling onto the blanket, then count everyone.

line.a_na_koc.text: The guests sit on the blanket. Drag the guest onto the blanket.

line.a_na_koc.lisek.text: The guests sit on the blanket. Drag the guest onto the blanket.

line.a_policz.text: Now count all the guests on the blanket.

line.a_troje.text: Three guests! Two and one more make three.

line.a_plus.text: We write it like this: two plus one equals three. Plus means: put together.

line.a_wiecej_gosci.text: More guests are coming: the snail and the butterfly!

line.a_przyprowadz.text: Bring them onto the blanket, to the other guests.

line.a_ktora_karta.text: Three plus two equals... Which card fits the empty place? Point to it.

line.a_ktora_karta_nie.text: Count all the guests on the blanket again.

line.a_pieciu.text: Five guests! Three and two more. Well done!

line.b_domino.text: After the picnic we play dominoes!

line.b_cztery.text: Which domino has four dots altogether? Point to it.

line.b_cztery_nie.text: Add the dots at the top and at the bottom.

line.b_jeden_i_trzy.text: One dot and three dots. Four altogether!

line.b_jeden_cztery.text: This domino has one dot and four dots. One plus four is five.

line.b_obracam.text: Now I turn the domino round! Four at the top, one at the bottom.

line.b_ile_teraz.text: Four plus one equals... How many dots are there now? Point to the card.

line.b_ile_teraz_nie.text: The dots haven't changed, only the domino turned round. Count them.

line.b_tyle_samo.text: Five! One plus four and four plus one are the same.

line.b_klaszczemy.text: Let's clap for the host! Listen: Fox claps, and then me.

line.b_ile_klasniec.text: How many claps were there altogether? Point to the card.

line.b_ile_klasniec_nie.text: Fox clapped twice and Bunny once. How many altogether?

line.b_koniec.text: Two and one make three. A wonderful picnic!

line.p_start.text: Let's practise adding! I have five games.

line.p_kosz.text: There are two apples in the basket. Add two more and count them all.

line.p_karta.text: Which card fits the empty place? Point to it.

line.p_karta.sarenka.text: Which card fits the empty place? Point to it.

line.p_karta_nie.text: Count again: first the first number, then add the second.

line.p_karta_nie.sarenka.text: Count again: first the first number, then add the second.

line.p_domino.text: Which domino has five dots altogether? Point to it.

line.p_domino_nie.text: Add the dots at the top and at the bottom.

line.p_sklep.text: The apple costs two coins and one more. Pay for it.

line.h_kubki.text: The guests came home for tea! There are two cups on the tray.

line.h_dostaw.text: Put two more cups on the tray.

line.h_ile.text: Two plus two equals... How many cups are there? Point to the card.

line.h_rodzice.text: Add with your parents: two apples and one more, how many altogether?

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for a wonderful picnic! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Fox's picnic blanket. We got it when we learnt to add.

line.a_czy_wszyscy.text: Is that everyone? I'll check my invitation. I painted everyone I invited on it.

line.a_kogo_brakuje.text: Hedgehog, Mouse and the duckling are already on the blanket. Who from the invitation isn't here yet? Point to everyone who is missing.

line.a_kogo_brakuje_nie.text: Look at the blanket. We're looking for the guests who aren't on it yet.

line.a_brakuje_dwoch.text: The snail and the butterfly! Two guests are still missing.

line.a_trzech_i_dwoch.text: There are three guests on the blanket, and two more are coming. When they come, we'll add them and count everyone.
